title: Terraform provisioner for EBS/EFS/S3 with snapshot verification and encryption-by-default
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a reusable Terraform 'provisioner' module that standardizes how Redwood Private provisions block, file, and object storage in customer VPCs: EBS volumes, EFS file systems, and S3 buckets. The module must enforce encryption-by-default (KMS key usage with envelope encryption), implement safe lifecycle heuristics for upgrades (create_before_destroy where applicable, resource tagging), and wire automated snapshot lifecycle policies plus a snapshot verification lambda that confirms successful snapshot creation, encryption, and cross-account copy when configured. Output must include stable resource names and provisioning metadata for downstream health checks.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes inputs for kms_key_id (optional), encryption_mode, retention_days, snapshot_schedule_cron, tags, and enable_cross_account_copy
EBS resources default to encrypted = true and use provided or generated KMS key; tf module should support kms_key rotation via alias
EFS provisioner creates mount targets in provided subnets, enforces encryption_in_transit, creates backup lifecycle rule in AWS Backup or DataLifecyclePolicy depending on account preferences

S3 buckets created with block_public_access, enforced bucket encryption (SSE-KMS) and a configurable lifecycle rule for object archival and delete; bucket policy includes least-privilege access for Redwood service role
Snapshot lifecycle triggers a Lambda-based verifier that checks completion, encryption metadata, and emits metrics to CloudWatch and Datadog; failures generate Ops alerts
Module supports an upgrade path: create_before_destroy for non-root resources, optional blue-green swap for stateful EFS endpoints, and documented manual steps for in-place EBS volume replacement
Integration tests run in CI that create a dedicated test VPC, provision EBS/EFS/S3, perform snapshot, verify verifier Lambda reports success, and teardown without leaving resources
Terraform plan drift detector added to the pipeline; module fails policy checks if encryption is disabled or public access is allowed
tasks: Design KMS key handling: customer-provided vs module-managed; define key alias convention
Implement EBS submodule with attachment options and snapshot lifecycle policy resource
Implement EFS submodule with backup/lifecycle toggle and mount target count calculations
Implement S3 submodule with encryption policy, lifecycle rules, and bucket lock decision tree
Build Lambda snapshot verifier with minimal IAM role, idempotent retries, and Datadog metric emission
Add Terraform examples and outputs: resource ARNs, snapshot IDs, provisioning metadata for Console/UI
Create CI integration test harness and add to nightly pipeline and PR gates
Write runbook and upgrade guide for Dedicated/Private operators
progress_updates: 2025-10-08: Kickoff meeting with infra and security. Agreed on KMS-by-default and no customer-exposed plaintext keys.

2026-02-28: CI integration harness added; nightly run creates test VPC and runs full provision/verify/teardown. Two intermittent teardown failures (fixed).
2026-03-10: Preparing PR for cross-account snapshot copy option and documentation. Opening RFC for blue-green EFS upgrade strategy.
